parts.name: enclosure-front-bottom
parts.model_overhangs_review: Four bodies on five labelled islands, the same as v3 and v4 (the audit's plate-strip floor and collet-plate feet, and the 40 mm core stops, take no support), on the same surfaces as the 09-21 v2 print: the two downward-open handhold lifting ceilings and the two Z-seam catch undersides, whose runs are 35.35 mm shorter at their fore ends where the carrier windows notch the rail. On the east the catch is carried, as in v2, by a ribbon rooted in its exposed groove; on the west the slicer reaches it with a branch of the bed-rooted handhold tree that climbs outside the west flank and enters the exposed groove under the catch. The handhold band (32.65 to 37.85) puts the ceilings' rim rounds and corner fillets on 0.08 mm layers; the slicer plans the trees on their own grid, 1438 layers against v2's 754. Clean the loose shell before any equipment or top shell is fitted; physical effort is unmeasured.

trees.contact_region: West bed-rooted tree: the west handhold lifting ceiling with its rim round and corner fillet (interface-1), and a branch that climbs outside the west flank (X-134.5..-107.5) to the west Z-seam catch underside (interface-4).
trees.removal_lane: After the plate comes off: detach the handhold branches and pull them down through the fully downward-open handhold; detach the catch branch outboard out of the exposed groove and break the trunk off outside the flank. The trunk stands clear of the flank; no hardware or top shell is over any of it.
trees.removal_direction_original_cad: -Z through the open bottom of the handhold; -X outboard out of the exposed west groove.
trees.preserved_working_face_reason: The broad flat handhold ceiling is the lifting surface and keeps its full roof and backing stock; its R6 rim is the show edge on the flank. The catch underside bears against the top shell foot along the complete rail; keep its flat square working face.

trees.contact_region: Small bed-rooted tree under the aft end of the west handhold ceiling, at the back seam (Y209..213), on interface-1.
trees.removal_lane: Detach from the ceiling and pull down through the open bottom of the handhold, or aft out of its open seam end.
trees.removal_direction_original_cad: -Z through the open handhold bottom, or +Y out of its seam end.
trees.preserved_working_face_reason: The broad flat handhold ceiling is the lifting surface and keeps its full roof and backing stock; its R6 rim is the show edge on the flank.

trees.contact_region: East bed-rooted tree: the east handhold lifting ceiling with its rim round and corner fillet (interface-2) and the ceiling's aft end at the back seam (interface-3).
trees.removal_lane: Detach from the ceiling and pull down through the fully downward-open handhold; both end walls stop the pocket along Y and its whole bottom is open.
trees.removal_direction_original_cad: -Z through the open bottom of the handhold.
trees.preserved_working_face_reason: The broad flat handhold ceiling is the lifting surface and keeps its full roof and backing stock; its R6 rim is the show edge on the flank.

trees.contact_region: East Z-seam catch ribbon, model-rooted on the floor of its exposed groove (print z 166.3), reaching the east catch underside (interface-5), as on the 09-21 print.
trees.removal_lane: Peel the narrow ribbon from the catch underside toward the outside of the flank; the whole groove is exposed above the shell's mouth, with no top shell or hardware over it.
trees.removal_direction_original_cad: +X outboard through the exposed east groove.
trees.preserved_working_face_reason: The catch underside bears against the top shell foot along the complete rail; keep its flat square working face.

interfaces.contact_region: West handhold lifting ceiling, flat at Z29.25 (X-101.5..-90.5 / Y180..212.6), with its R6 rim round and corner fillet, over the downward-open finger pocket.
East handhold lifting ceiling, flat at Z29.25 (X+90.5..+101.5 / Y180..212.6), with its R6 rim round and corner fillet, over the downward-open finger pocket.
Aft end of the east handhold ceiling at the back seam, X+90.3..+92.7 / Y210..212.8, Z29.25.
West Z-seam catch underside at Z169.20 over its flank groove, Y129.2..190.4: the run now starts aft of the carrier window's notch (Y93.8..129.2).
East Z-seam catch underside at Z169.20 over its flank groove, Y129.2..190.4: the run now starts aft of the carrier window's notch (Y93.8..129.2).

native_log_diagnostics_review: The diagnostics are the T1001, T65535 and T65279 parser messages every plate from petgf.3mf carries: T1001 is the saved machine_start_gcode's hotend type detection, before the first layer; T65535 and T65279 are in its machine_end_gcode, after the last layer. Native return code 0, empty plate warning, black filament on nozzle 0.
